note: Results of folding each published corpus through the implementation, recorded with the SHA-256 of the file that was read. scripts/conformance-run.py uses a row only when that digest still matches the corpus on disk, so a regenerated or upgraded corpus invalidates the record rather than silently keeping a stale pass. Every suite but collation also closes a #eval gate over its whole corpus during the UnicodeFullConformance build, so its row here restates a check the build already makes; the collation rows are the evidence itself, because a run over 437,928 pairs is hours rather than minutes. Regenerate the collation rows with scripts/conformance-execute.sh.

runs.note: A row carries a bitset naming which paragraph directions it asserts, so 490846 rows expand to 770241 cases. Rows are reported in the suite table because that is the unit the other suites count; the case figure is the one the file actually asserts.

Full-corpus fold through the UTS #46 processor via scripts/idna-conformance.sh all; every row judged on all three result columns. The IdnaTestV2 module also closes a build-time gate over the same file, so this row restates a check the UnicodeFullConformance build already makes.
Adjacent pairs, not rows: a corpus of n lines publishes n-1 order assertions, each that the line's sort key does not exceed the next line's.
